attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), enabled the AppArmor mandatory access control LSM (present in the kernel but disabled by default), deployed a small inventory HTTP application serving JSON inventory data on TCP 8181, confined it under a dedicated enforcing AppArmor profile launched via aa-exec, and enabled everything to persist across boot via OpenRC. Rebooted node1 as the mandatory restart-evidence step and verified after restart that AppArmor is active, the inventory-app process is running in enforce (not complain/unconfined) mode, a real policy denial was logged proving active enforcement, and the inventory app remains reachable and correct over $NODE_IP:8181.
